name: MotoCMS
description_en:
MotoCMS currently presents Moto4 as a hosted visual website builder for beginners and small businesses. Users choose a template, edit content and global styles, then publish; Pro adds custom domains, hosting and documented blog/eCommerce functionality. AI design assistance and integrations support that workflow, but vendor speed and search-performance claims are not independent test results.

Do not confuse current Moto4 subscriptions with older MotoCMS 3/HTML/Flash products installed on customer servers. The current terms say MotoCMS 3 reached end of life on July 1, 2025. A legacy lifetime license preserves its applicable usage rights without promising continuing security updates, support or future server compatibility.
description_zh:
MotoCMS 当前将 Moto4 定位为面向新手及小企业的托管可视化建站工具。用户选择模板、编辑内容和全局样式后发布；Pro 增加自定义域名、托管，以及文档所述博客和电商能力。AI 设计辅助和集成支持这一流程，但厂商的速度及搜索效果描述不是独立测试结论。

当前 Moto4 订阅应与安装在客户服务器上的旧 MotoCMS 3/HTML/Flash 产品区分。当前条款称 MotoCMS 3 于 2025 年 7 月 1 日结束生命周期；旧终身许可保留适用使用权，不承诺持续安全更新、支持或未来服务器兼容性。

core_features.name_zh: 托管式 Moto4 构建器
core_features.explanation_en: Edit a predesigned template with visual controls; current Pro includes infrastructure rather than requiring a legacy server installation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过可视化控制编辑预设模板；当前 Pro 包含基础设施，无需采用旧版自有服务器安装方式。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro’s blog exposes drafts/published status and SEO fields; Moto4 can preserve page slugs or import redirect CSVs during a rebuild.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 博客提供草稿/发布状态和 SEO 字段，Moto4 重建站点时可保留页面 slug 或批量导入重定向 CSV。

core_features.explanation_en: FAQ lists up to 100 manual backups for Pro and 5 during trial, with daily automated recovery requested through support.
core_features.explanation_zh: FAQ 列出 Pro 最多 100 份手动备份、试用最多 5 份，自动每日备份恢复需联系支持。

pricing.summary_en: Terms acknowledge Free with unspecified current quotas; homepage Pro displays $10.75/month annual or $15 month-to-month, plus a no-card 14-day trial. Currency/tax/domain renewal and actual plan-screen limits need confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: 条款承认 Free，但当前配额未列；首页 Pro 年付月均 $10.75、逐月 $15，并提供免卡 14 天试用，币种/税费/域名续费及实际方案限额需确认。

sections.title_en: Use the trial to test one complete site journey
sections.title_zh: 用试用验证完整网站流程
sections.en: The homepage starts with a no-card 14-day trial: sign up, choose a template, replace text/images/contact details, apply brand colors/fonts and publish when ready. It also warns that switching a trial template does not preserve edits made to the previous one. Prepare content before extensive styling and check the trial’s actual publishing/domain limits. A useful pilot is a service page with a contact action and a blog post, viewed on mobile and desktop, rather than treating the vendor’s AI-design or responsiveness promises as acceptance evidence. No signup or generated site was tested here.
sections.zh: 首页提供免银行卡的 14 天试用，流程为注册、选模板、替换文字/图片/联系方式、设置品牌颜色/字体，再按需发布。页面也提醒试用中切换模板不会保留前一模板修改，应先准备内容，再进行大量样式工作，并检查试用实际发布/域名限制。可用服务页面、联系行动和一篇博客作为试点，同时检查手机与桌面，不能将厂商 AI 设计或响应式承诺当作验收证据。本次未注册或测试生成网站。

sections.title_en: Distinguish a free start from Pro operation
sections.title_zh: 区分免费开始与 Pro 运营
sections.en: The Pro card displays $10.75/month paid annually or $15/month month-to-month, including hosting, SSL, multiple contributors, analytics/custom-code integration, no Moto4 ads and a domain “in 1 year” offer. The exact currency code, annual charge, domain eligibility/renewal and checkout taxes were not established. The FAQ requires Pro for custom domains, Blog and eCommerce; these are not proved included in unrestricted free use. Terms acknowledge a Free plan but leave its quotas to the current plan screen. A 14-day trial and a Free plan are different entitlements. Obtain the actual plan limits and renewal quote before relying on a live business site.
sections.zh: Pro 卡片显示年付月均 $10.75，逐月 $15，列出托管、SSL、多贡献者、分析/自定义代码集成、移除 Moto4 广告及措辞为“in 1 year”的域名优惠。具体货币代码、年付总额、域名资格/续费及税费尚未确立。FAQ 要求 Pro 才可使用自定义域名、博客和电商，不能认定无限制免费使用包含这些能力。条款承认 Free 方案，但配额以当前方案界面为准；14 天试用与 Free 是不同权利。依赖线上业务网站前应取得实际限额和续费报价。

sections.title_en: Keep URL and content controls explicit
sections.title_zh: 明确 URL 与内容控制
sections.en: The FAQ describes blog post name/URL, author, date and draft/published status, plus metadata, canonical and image ALT fields. When rebuilding an old site, preserve slugs where possible or configure Moto4 redirects, including CSV bulk input, then verify important old URLs before switching traffic. The FAQ explicitly places header/footer Code Injection in MotoCMS 3, whereas the current Moto4 Pro card says Custom Code Integration; do not assume those editors or insertion locations are identical. Sitemap/robots automation and CDN are vendor-described capabilities, not proof of immediate indexing or improved rankings.
sections.zh: FAQ 描述博客名称/URL、作者、日期、草稿/发布状态，以及元数据、canonical 和图片 ALT 字段。重建旧站时可尽量保留 slug，或配置 Moto4 重定向并用 CSV 批量输入，切换流量前应验证重要旧 URL。FAQ 将头尾 Code Injection 明确放在 MotoCMS 3，而当前 Moto4 Pro 卡片写 Custom Code Integration，不能假定两代编辑器或插入位置相同。网站地图/robots 自动化和 CDN 是厂商描述能力，不证明即时索引或排名提升。

sections.title_en: Backups and cancellation do not establish portability
sections.title_zh: 备份与取消不等于可迁移性
sections.en: Moto4 Pro can keep up to 100 manual cloud backups, trial up to 5; manual recovery occurs in the account and daily automated recovery goes through support. These are platform recovery tools, not proof of a downloadable, independently runnable site. Terms say cancellation generally ends at the paid period, renewal can be automatic, and Pro-dependent sites may become unpublished or restricted without renewal. Data can be retained or deleted under applicable policies. Unless purchase terms differ, an initial Moto4 payment may be refund-eligible within 14 days, with renewal refunds not automatic. Confirm retention, export and restore behavior before ending a subscription; no restore/export was executed here.
sections.zh: Moto4 Pro 最多保留 100 份手动云备份，试用最多 5 份；手动恢复在账户内执行，每日自动备份恢复需联系支持。这是平台恢复工具，不证明能下载独立运行的网站。条款称取消通常在已付费期末生效，续费可能自动执行，不续费时依赖 Pro 的网站可能取消发布或受限，数据可按适用政策保留或删除。除购买条件另有规定，Moto4 首次付款可能在 14 天内符合退款条件，续费不自动退款。结束订阅前应确认数据保留、导出和恢复行为；本次未执行恢复/导出。

sections.title_en: Treat legacy ownership as a separate operating decision
sections.title_zh: 将旧版使用权作为独立运营决策
sections.en: The terms identify MotoCMS 3 as discontinued and end-of-life since July 1, 2025, with legacy perpetual rights subject to their original license. They explicitly distinguish those rights from future development, security updates, support and compatibility. Existing owners operate their own hosting and backups; a current Moto4 hosted subscription is not documented as an automatic equivalent migration. Moto4 may suit a small business comfortable with a managed template workflow. Teams needing self-managed current software, unrestricted source rights or guaranteed complete backend export should obtain explicit evidence first. No open-source license, legacy upgrade or account compatibility was verified.
sections.zh: 条款将 MotoCMS 3 标为自 2025 年 7 月 1 日起停产并结束生命周期，旧永久权利受原许可约束，明确与未来开发、安全更新、支持和兼容性区分。旧版所有者自行维护主机和备份；当前 Moto4 托管订阅没有被证明是自动等价迁移。接受托管模板流程的小企业可考虑 Moto4；需要当前自管软件、无限制源码权利或完整后端导出的团队应先取得明确证据。本次未确认开源许可，也未验证旧版升级或账户兼容性。
